corrections:
No wire-field errors. Two cosmetic-only nits in the Map's prose (not on the wire, do not affect any synthesizer that uses the templates):
1) UI-string transcription: Map 0x56e20 meaning says UI '요청입니다' and 0x56e66 says '공지사항 요청입니다', but the actual EUC-KR literals are '...요청중입니다' (missing the '중' syllable): sl+0x490 fo 0xa9618 = 'SMS 요청중입니다.', sl+0x498 fo 0xa9638 = '공지사항 요청중입니다.'. (0x56de2 slot-info UI at sl+0x48c = '슬롯 정보 요청중입니다.' matches Map.)
2) Struct-base shorthand: Map field_notes write '*(ctx+0x38)', '*(ctx+0x4c)', '*(ctx+0x40)'. The real base pointer is the sub-struct at ctx+0xa3ac (from bl 0x14ad10 + 0xa3ac), so these are *(ctx+0xa3ac+0x38) etc. Offsets are correct relative to that sub-struct; only the base label is abbreviated. Likewise the seq counter '*(*(sl+0x16c)+0xc)' and 0x56fb0's 'base+0xaca8' are ctx-relative — all confirmed, just naming shorthand. Neither nit changes any byte template or field order.
